USERNAME_TOO_LONG.en: The '{{username}}' is too long. Must not exceed {{username_max_chars}} characters
USERNAME_TOO_LONG.es: El '{{username}}' es demasiado largo. No debe exceder {{username_max_chars}} caracteres

INVALID_USERNAME.en: The '{{username}}' can only contain letters, both uppercase and lowercase, and numbers, and cannot contain spaces or special characters
INVALID_USERNAME.es: El '{{username}}' solo puede contener letras, mayúsculas, minúsculas y numeros, y no puede contener espacios ni caracteres especiales

EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS.en: The '{{email}}' address you provided is already registered
EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS.es: La '{{email}}' electrónico que proporcionó ya está registrada

PASSWORD_MISSING_DIGIT.en: '{{password}}' must contain at least one digit
PASSWORD_MISSING_DIGIT.es: '{{password}}' debe contener al menos un dígito

PASSWORD_MISSING_LOWERCASE.en: '{{password}}' must contain at least one lowercase letter
PASSWORD_MISSING_LOWERCASE.es: '{{password}}' debe contener al menos una letra minúscula

PASSWORD_MISSING_SPECIAL_CHAR.en: '{{password}}' must contain at least one special character, such as {{password_allowed_symbols}}
PASSWORD_MISSING_SPECIAL_CHAR.es: '{{password}}' debe contener al menos un carácter especial, como {{password_allowed_symbols}}

PASSWORD_MISSING_UPPERCASE.en: '{{password}}' must contain at least one uppercase letter
PASSWORD_MISSING_UPPERCASE.es: '{{password}}' debe contener al menos una letra mayúscula

USERNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS.en: The '{{username}}' you provided is already taken
USERNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS.es: El '{{username}}' que proporcionó ya está en uso

PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT.en: '{{password}}' must be at least {{password_min_length}} characters long
